literal: The deceitful conduct of those who say 'We are without attachment' will bring many ruins, saying 'Alas! Alas!'
translation: The false conduct of those who claim, 'We have renounced all attachments,' will bring them many miseries, making them cry out in deep regret, 'Alas, what have I done!'
modern: பற்றுக்களைத் துறந்துவிட்டோம் என்று கூறுபவர்களின் வஞ்சகமான ஒழுக்கம், 'ஐயோ! ஐயோ!' என்று அவர்கள் வருந்தும்படி பல துன்பங்களைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the hypocrisy of false ascetics who pretend to have renounced all worldly desires while secretly indulging in them. The word 'படிற்று' means deceitful or false, and 'ஒழுக்கம்' refers to conduct. The phrase 'எற்று எற்று' is an exclamation of intense grief and regret ('Alas! Alas!'). The poet emphasizes that such deceitful behavior will eventually be exposed, bringing numerous miseries ('ஏதம் பலவும்') that will make the hypocrites lament their actions in deep sorrow.
